prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1171; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in League City, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had slowed down and was waiting for a clear gap before completing the turn, so I was moving very slowly at the moment of impact. The collision twisted my body toward the driver's side and my left knee hit the dashboard and door frame. I felt sharp pain right away and had trouble putting weight on the leg. I gave the same description of how the collision happened to the officer at the scene, to the other driver, and later to the adjuster when I called in the claim. I am the named driver on this policy, and I have kept copies of the police report and my medical discharge papers for the file.
